code:
log_a = np.log(price_a)
log_b = np.log(price_b)
beta, c = np.polyfit(
    log_b, log_a, deg=1)
spread = log_a - beta*log_b
caption: The hedge ratio is an OLS beta between two log prices, not a benchmark.

code:
m = spread.rolling(60).mean()
s = spread.rolling(60).std()
z = (spread - m) / s
z = z.shift(1)
long = z < -2.0
short = z > 2.0
caption: Long the spread when it's too low, short when too high.
